//: Vite transpiles TS itself, so tsc is used only as a type checker (noEmit).
`npm run typecheck` is the CI gate; `vite build` does not type-check.
noImplicitAny and strictNullChecks are enabled here rather than in
tsconfig.base.json because the base is shared with desktop/, which has not
been assessed. server/ sets the same flags in its own config. strict and
allowJs are deliberately still off — see CLAUDE.md for the measured counts.
